# OperatorOS

> The modular command layer for modern business operations. One console, shared sign-on, billing, and role-aware access for your entire product ecosystem.

## Pages

- [Home](https://operatoros.net/): Platform overview and ecosystem introduction.
- [Pricing](https://operatoros.net/pricing): Plans and module pricing.
- [How It Works](https://operatoros.net/how-it-works): Four-step onboarding flow.
- [Ecosystem](https://operatoros.net/ecosystem): All active and planned modules.
- [Modules](https://operatoros.net/modules): Module gateway and category listing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://operatoros.net/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms](https://operatoros.net/terms): Terms and conditions.
